name: number-range-field
title: Number range field
description: From and To fields for filters: either end can stay open, an end below the start is explained in words, and one unit sits beside both.
docs: value and onValueChange speak { min, max } where an open end is null. A range whose end is below its start is never reported: it is explained in words when a field is left (The maximum cannot be below the minimum of 60,000 km) and the later field carries aria-invalid until it is right. min and max bound both ends (typing outside them is brought in when the field is left, with a line saying so), step is what an arrow key adds and Shift makes ten times as much, and the arrow keys never take the end below the start. Home and End go to the limits. unit is shown at the end of both fields, label is the legend of the group, locale writes the numbers and decides what a lone comma or point means (1,500 is fifteen hundred where a comma groups; digits of any script, such as Arabic-Indic, Bengali or Devanagari, are understood when typing), grouping=false drops the thousands separator for numbers that are not amounts, such as a year, name posts <name>-min and <name>-max, and labels renames every phrase including the No min and No max placeholders. The two ends sit side by side while the group is wide enough for a number and its unit in each, and stack in a column (with a small to between them) when the group itself is narrower, the sooner the longer the unit is, which is a matter of the group's width and not of the screen's, so a card on a phone does not clip a number. The fields are spinbuttons that read their value with the unit.
